Final borderline because full text was unavailable in this screening; retry from an institutional/author archive.

records.title: TAO: Re-Thinking DL-based Microarchitecture Simulation
records.reason: TAO replaces expensive simulation with a learned/deep-learning-based microarchitecture simulator and evaluates prediction fidelity/runtime on architecture-design benchmarks. It is a simulator rather than a model or LLM-serving optimization; linked FPGA inference is only a possible downstream use. Keep borderline because efficiency could be indirectly useful for accelerator exploration, but no direct connection is evidenced.

records.title: LTrans-OPU: A Low-Latency FPGA-Based Overlay Processor for Transformer Networks
records.reason: Tried the IEEE publisher record and author publication index; no accessible primary full paper was available, only bibliographic/abstract-level material. LTrans-OPU is described as an FPGA overlay processor with hybrid pruning, custom instructions and latency gains, but full method/evaluation/limitations were not read here. Final borderline pending institutional/author full text.

records.title: Memory-Efficient Backpropagation for Fine-Tuning LLMs on Resource-Constrained Mobile Devices
records.reason: The method targets memory-efficient backpropagation for fine-tuning LLMs on mobile/resource-constrained devices and evaluates training memory/quality. It does not address inference generation or serving and has no inference-time latency/KV-cache result. The linked 1-bit LLM compression connection is not strong enough to convert a training-only method into a direct inference followup.
